name: A fake flood
claim: Proves: a lying sensor cannot make the Brain act.
description: The harbour gauge reads a steady 0.3 m. Then a second, compromised gauge reports 1.8 m, which would be a flood. Its readings are signed but the Guardian marks them untrusted.
expected_brain: Notices the doubtful reading and opens a flood incident, but the Safety gate refuses both the warning and the valve call: no trusted Guardian verdict stands behind them. The honest gauge then clears the incident. Nothing reaches the city.
how_to_verify: Visible on the timeline screen; log logs/t13-*.jsonl; `uv run brain scenario t13`.
